answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. What survives to the quill is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on time-locked work history, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. A relic of per-task receipts records who did what, and the walnut of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
